requirements.title: TRIM result characteristics
requirements.definition: The result is character with the same kind as STRING and length equal to STRING length minus its trailing blanks, with zero length for a STRING containing no nonblank characters.

pending.TRIM-result-character-same-kind: Use default character scalar STRING='AB  ' and assert KIND(TRIM(STRING))==KIND(STRING) together with exact value 'AB'.
pending.TRIM-result-length-drops-trailing-blanks: Use STRING=' A B   ' initialized from a nonblank literal and assert LEN(TRIM(STRING))==4 and value ' A B'; companion STRING='XYZ' asserts length three.
pending.TRIM-all-blank-result-zero-length: Use STRING='   ' and assert LEN(TRIM(STRING))==0, paired with STRING=' X ' returning length two and value ' X'.
